```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
source(if (file.exists("supplement/report-helpers.R")) "supplement/report-helpers.R" else "report-helpers.R")

variants <- tibble::tribble(
  ~bundle, ~label,
  "measurement_prereg_methods_update_2026", "Registered measurement methods",
  "measurement_direct_only_update_2026", "MRI/CT/ultrasound/biopsy only"
) |>
  mutate(
    data = map(bundle, ~ read_bundle(.x, "sample_rows.csv.gz")),
    selection = map(bundle, ~ read_bundle(.x, "selection_summary.csv.gz")),
    audit = map(bundle, ~ read_bundle(.x, "selection_audit.csv.gz")),
    predictions = map2(bundle, label, ~ normalise_predictions(read_bundle(.x, "dose_response_predictions.csv.gz"), .y, "g/kg/day")),
    diagnostics = map2(bundle, label, diagnostic_row),
    equivalence = map2(bundle, label, local_equivalence_summary)
  )

original_data <- read_bundle("primary_update_2026", "sample_rows.csv.gz") |>
  filter(analysis_outcome == "hypertrophy")
original_predictions <- normalise_predictions(
  read_bundle("primary_update_2026", "dose_response_predictions.csv.gz") |>
    filter(outcome == "hypertrophy"),
  "Primary measurement eligibility", "g/kg/day"
)
prediction_data <- bind_rows(original_predictions, variants$predictions) |>
  mutate(analysis = factor(
    analysis,
    levels = c(
      "Primary measurement eligibility",
      "Registered measurement methods",
      "MRI/CT/ultrasound/biopsy only"
    )
  ))

sample_summary <- bind_rows(
  analysis_sample_row(original_data, "Primary measurement eligibility", FALSE),
  map2_dfr(variants$data, variants$label, ~ analysis_sample_row(.x, .y, FALSE))
)

primary_diag <- read_bundle("primary_update_2026", "diagnostic_summary.csv.gz") |>
  filter(outcome == "hypertrophy")
primary_exact <- read_bundle("primary_update_2026", "loo_exact_refit_summary.csv.gz") |>
  filter(outcome == "hypertrophy")
diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    Analysis = "Primary measurement eligibility",
    `Accepted fits` = nrow(primary_diag),
    `Fits passing final diagnostics` = sum(primary_diag$diagnostic_pass),
    `Exact LOO refits` = nrow(primary_exact),
    `Exact refits passing` = sum(primary_exact$diagnostic_pass)
  ),
  bind_rows(variants$diagnostics)
)

selection_summary <- bind_rows(map2(variants$selection, variants$label, ~ mutate(.x, Analysis = .y))) |>
  select(Analysis, original_rows, retained_rows, excluded_rows, studies, arms)

decision_summary <- bind_rows(map2(variants$audit, variants$label, ~ mutate(.x, Analysis = .y))) |>
  count(Analysis, decision, sort = TRUE)

equivalence <- bind_rows(variants$equivalence)

meaningful_summary <- map2_dfr(variants$bundle, variants$label, function(bundle, label) {
  x <- read_bundle(bundle, "supported_meaningful_contrasts.csv.gz") |>
    filter(
      supported %in% TRUE,
      protein_intake_proposed > protein_intake_current,
      probability_meaningful_benefit >= 0.95 | probability_meaningful_detriment >= 0.95
    )
  tibble::tibble(Analysis = label, `Supported meaningful contrasts` = nrow(x))
})
```

# Why these analyses were required

The registered measures-of-muscle-size-or-mass outcome allowed imaging and biopsy measurements together with appendicular DXA and BIA regional proxies. The original fitted primary implementation was broader and also retained trunk and skinfold-derived measurements. The first analysis here restricts the outcome to the methods written in the registration and is therefore the principal sensitivity check against the primary analysis; it does not retroactively relabel the fitted primary analysis.

A stricter post-registration sensitivity retains MRI, CT, ultrasound, and muscle-biopsy measurements only. It tests whether the conclusion depends on appendicular DXA/BIA proxies. Because the restriction changes both the measurements and the contributing studies, differences cannot be attributed solely to measurement error or method.

# Eligibility audit

```{r}
#| label: tbl-measurement-selection
#| tbl-cap: "Measurement eligibility and final analysis samples."
knitr::kable(selection_summary, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-measurement-decisions
#| tbl-cap: "Row-level eligibility decisions recorded by the measurement audit."
knitr::kable(decision_summary, align = c("l", "l", "r"))
```

The pre-registration-as-written restriction removes 12 of the 425 primary-analysis muscle rows. The direct-only sensitivity retains 255 rows from 29 studies and 84 arms.

# Diagnostics and model averaging

Each analysis retains the same 26 relative-intake candidate identities for the muscle outcome. Sampling diagnostics, corrected observation-level LOO, outcome-specific stacking, posterior-mixture curves, pairwise contrasts, and local-equivalence summaries were regenerated separately for each restricted dataset.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-measurement-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Final diagnostic and exact-LOO status."
knitr::kable(diagnostics, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

# Dose-response comparison

```{r}
#| label: fig-measurement-curves
#| fig-cap: "Relative-intake dose-response curves under the primary measurement eligibility, registered measurement methods, and direct imaging/biopsy-only eligibility. Ribbons are marginal 95% posterior intervals."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5

ggplot(prediction_data, aes(dose, estimate, colour = analysis, fill = analysis)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), alpha = 0.10, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~rt, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", labeller = report_facet_labels()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = report_curve_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = report_curve_colours) +
  labs(x = report_dose_axes[["relative"]], y = "Standardised Mean Change", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  report_theme()
```

The registered-method curves and inferential conclusions are similar to those under the primary measurement eligibility. The direct-only analysis is also similar with RT. Without RT, its curve is steeper and substantially less precise because the restricted evidence base is smaller.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-measurement-meaningful
#| tbl-cap: "Supported contrasts meeting the 95% meaningful-difference criterion."
knitr::kable(meaningful_summary, align = c("l", "r"))
```

Neither retained analysis identifies a supported contrast meeting the posterior-probability criterion for a meaningful gain from increasing intake or a meaningful loss from decreasing it.

# Local practical equivalence

```{r}
#| label: tbl-measurement-equivalence
#| tbl-cap: "Local practical-equivalence radii in g/kg/day."
equivalence |>
  mutate(
    across(c(equivalent_radius, equivalent_radius_q10, equivalent_radius_q90), ~ sprintf("%.2f", .x)),
    supported_current_intakes = format_count(supported_current_intakes)
  ) |>
  rename(
    `Median radius` = equivalent_radius,
    `Q10 radius` = equivalent_radius_q10,
    `Q90 radius` = equivalent_radius_q90,
    `Supported current intakes` = supported_current_intakes
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "l")
```

Local practical equivalence remains supported, although the direct-only equivalence regions are generally narrower, especially without RT. This reflects reduced precision as well as changed measurement eligibility.

# Interpretation

Restricting the muscle outcome to the registered measurement scope does not materially alter the primary conclusion. Restricting further to direct imaging and biopsy measurements also does not reveal a supported meaningful gain that was hidden by the broader measurement set. The direct-only analysis provides useful reassurance about robustness but should not be described as isolating a pure measurement-method effect.
